root_cause.text: The exynos_clkout_probe() function in the Samsung clock driver performed an array access to .hws[] before setting the .num member of the __counted_by-annotated struct, causing an out-of-bounds access (UBSAN warning) because the bounds checker sees .num as zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `clkout->data.num = EXYNOS_CLKOUT_NR_CLKS;` assignment to before the line `clkout->data.hws[0] = ...`, as shown in the diff. The commit message explicitly states that the UBSAN warning occurs because ".num being assigned after .hws[] has been accessed".
